_readme: TMP_009 iteration 5 spike — Phase A.v3 after iter 4 showed `realisticFantasy_v30 + isty03 LoRA` produced shrubs but isty03 forced multi-object dioramas with explicit tile/tray bases (8/9 fail on C3). Snow_frost s303 in iter 4 produced a single isolated subject despite the LoRA — evidence the base alone may handle isolated-prop output. This iteration drops the LoRA entirely to isolate base model behaviour: ZERO LoRAs, same base, same hardened negative, same fixture. If base alone produces single isolated shrubs → we have a working pipeline at 0-LoRA cost and ~7 s/img.
